What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Hondo Ohnaka]]: left, the image of [[Hondo Ohnaka]] (holotable commit 022435b); right, the image of [[Hondo Ohnaka (Errata)]] (holotable commit 25528d7). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Dark/large/hondoohnaka.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/25528d7b73b5e6206de765d700504be693fc39da/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Dark/large/hondoohnaka.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
